headline: Six Sectors See Base Exchanges Intensify
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the map’s most volatile corridors have shifted markedly. Nevish Line still leads with fifty‑six ownership changes in the past day, yet the two‑hour casualty trend has cooled to roughly 60 colonial and 63 Warden losses per hour even as the most recent hour shows a sharp uptick to 121 and 126 respectively. Callahans Passage remains a meat‑grinder with twenty‑two flips; the last hour records 1,354 colonial and 1,169 Warden casualties, both accelerating, while enlistments dip. Weathered Expanse has risen to thirty‑three exchanges; a sudden surge to 413 colonial and 559 Warden casualties in the latest hour contrasts with a two‑hour cooling trend. Palantine Berm’s flips have fallen to forty, but the newest hour shows colonial losses accelerating to 25 per hour and Warden losses to 2, with enlistments also rising. Kuura Strand stays quiet at eleven flips, casualty rates flat and enlistments only modestly accelerating. Mooring County holds six flips; the latest hour spikes to 101 colonial and 67 Warden casualties, yet the two‑hour window shows a strong cooling. Stlican Shelf adds eight flips with a fresh hour of 149 colonial and 263 Warden casualties accelerating. All other regions remain largely static, held wholly by one side with only low‑level attrition.
